anchor: A heavy metal object dropped into water to keep a boat from floating away.
breeze: A gentle and refreshing light wind.
bridge: A structure built over a river or road so people can cross.
candle: A stick of wax with a string inside that gives light when burning.
canyon: A deep valley with steep rock sides often carved by a river.
castle: A large strong building built in the past to protect against attacks.
compass: A tool with a magnetic needle that always points north.
curious: Eager to learn or know more about something.
desert: A large dry land area with very little rain and few plants.
detective: A person who looks for clues to solve crimes or mysteries.
dragon: A mythical giant creature that breathes fire and has scales.
echo: A sound that bounces off a surface and returns to your ears.
explore: To travel through a new place in order to discover it.
forest: A large area of land covered with many trees.
fossil: The preserved remains or mark of an ancient animal or plant in rock.
fountain: A decorative structure that shoots water up into the air.
glacier: A massive slow moving sheet of ice formed on mountains.
glimmer: A faint or unsteady light that shines softly.
harvest: The process of gathering ripe crops from fields.
island: A piece of land completely surrounded by water.
journey: An act of traveling from one place to another.
jungle: A thick tropical forest full of wild animals and plants.
lantern: A portable light source enclosed in a protective case.
legend: An old traditional story that is well known but may not be true.
magnet: A piece of metal that can pull iron objects toward itself.
meadow: A grassy field often filled with wild flowers.
melody: A pleasing arrangement of musical notes that forms a tune.
mirror: A smooth glass surface that reflects a clear image.
museum: A place where historic, artistic, or scientific objects are displayed.
mystic: Something having a spiritual or magical nature.
harbor: A safe area of water where ships park near land.
orchard: A piece of land where fruit trees are grown.
palace: A grand house where a king or queen lives.
planet: A large round body in space that moves around a star.
puzzle: A game or problem that tests your cleverness and patience.
pyramid: A giant stone structure with triangular sides meeting at a point.
rainbow: An arch of colors that appears in the sky after rain.
rescue: To save someone or something from danger.
riddle: A tricky question worded in a way that requires clever thinking.
shadow: A dark shape formed when an object blocks light.
statue: A carved or molded figure of a person or animal.
summit: The highest peak or top point of a mountain.
treasure: A collection of valuable items like gold, coins, or jewels.
tunnel: An underground passageway built through a hill or under a road.
valley: A low area of land situated between hills or mountains.
volcano: A mountain that can erupt with hot liquid rock and ash.
whisper: To speak in a very quiet voice using breath instead of tone.
wisdom: The ability to make good decisions using knowledge and experience.
wizard: A person in stories who possesses magic powers.
